Proposed amendment to the Articles of Association
To consider and, if thought fit, pass the following resolutions BY WAY OF SPECIAL RESOLUTION:
THAT, the Articles of Association of the Company be amended by inserting a new Article 54A
immediately after Article 54 to read as follows:
“54A. Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 54 and 58, the Members may, if they think fit, or if
the Directors notify them that such is the manner in which any particular general meeting would be
held, hold a physical, virtual or hybrid meeting”.
